limits: The 96 sampler requests use independent Python claim parity; they are not 96 native-qualified episodes. The 27-branch hand-constructed grammar boundary is Python-only; actual sampled profiles reach 22 branches.
The teaching audit covers two seeds, both settings and 13 declared rivals. All-seed coverage, universal identifiability and measured training benefit are not established.
Qualification uses six demos to cover the full bank; the independent teaching audit checks the two-demo minimum, and the ordinary adapter/export default is three.
Causal intermediate facts and interpretation are authored metadata. Protected construction and replay verify final labels; no iterative-state or universal causal-depth claim is made.
The static release checker reads retained bytes/JSON only and performs zero new reference evaluations. Saved-file conformance does not test a turn controller.
Production, canonical authority, approval and review index are unchanged. The unchanged production battery and historical selected-test collection issue were not rerun.
Owner acceptance was not performed. No training data or model trajectories were admitted.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived trunk endpoints, orientation, perpendicular line coordinate and endpoint span; these give each remaining red cell its branch role and side of the trunk.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find the unique row- or column-aligned pair of red cells, then derive its trunk orientation, line and span from the current input.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Fill the inferred trunk span and connect each branch along the perpendicular axis, toward the inferred trunk line or away from that line to the canvas edge according to the episode setting.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The same branch position can lie on either side of a trunk found elsewhere in the input. Replacing the inferred line by the canvas midpoint changes both trunk pixels and the later branch routing. The exact intervention retains red scanning, pair selection, orientation and painting code; it changes only the consumed line coordinate. This is a geometry-derived dependency, not iterative state simulation.

parametric_work.summary: Source-bound native qualification covers both branch_direction settings at seeds 0/17 with the full six-demo/four-query bank. The exact canonical default is preserved. Input-derived aligned-pair/trunk geometry controls later branch routing, with two exact-program midpoint-line interventions constructed and replayed through protected Racket. Ordinary defaults remain three demonstrations and four queries. Exact-source owner integration, qualification and acceptance remain required.

question_answer.rule: Find and fill the correct trunk, then connect only the first five non-endpoint red cells in row-major order.
question_answer.selection_scope: Only survivor among the 13 predeclared rivals on the four original canonical demonstrations, with branch counts 2,3,5,3. The augmented duplicate ledger row was excluded because it adds the original held-out pair to training. This is not a globally strongest-rule claim.
question_answer.support: The separate native family emits this case. The unchanged production sampler caps branches at five and cannot emit it.
question_answer.verification: Eight fresh protected Racket applications verify both programs on four original canonical demos. Two exact prior native-audit applications supply the counterexample outputs, with current input, program, source and runtime hashes checked. The current native generator reproduces the input.

remaining_failures: The inherited old-source semantic-assurance audit remains needs_triage in the task review index. This native proposal does not resolve that index entry or change production approval.
report.summary: Built a native branch-direction adapter that reuses the exact canonical/two-setting programs, independently supports 2–6 demonstrations and 1–4 queries, and constructs meaningful 10..30 grids with larger branch counts. Both core demonstrations refute all 13 tested rivals. Retained evidence includes 57 focused passing tests, 96/96 Python sampler requests, 112 protected teaching-audit evaluations, 64 native qualification evaluations, 20 executed export evaluations and two replayed causal witnesses. Reviewer-ready; owner acceptance pending.
